source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bands = []
    r = 0
    while r < h:
        row = grid[r]
        if row[0] == row[-1] and row[0] != bg and len(set(row[1:-1])) == 1:
            fill, border = row[1], row[0]
            start = r
            while r < h and grid[r] == row:
                r += 1
            bands.append((start, r - 1, fill, border))
        else:
            r += 1
    first_band = min(b[0] for b in bands)
    occupied = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(first_band))]
    groups = []
    for c in occupied:
        if not groups or c > groups[-1][-1] + 1:
            groups.append([c])
        else:
            groups[-1].append(c)
    for group in groups:
        x0, x1 = group[0], group[-1]
        ys = [r for r in range(first_band) if any(grid[r][c] != bg for c in group)]
        y0, y1 = min(ys), max(ys)
        cells = [(y,x) for y in range(y0,y1+1) for x in range(x0,x1+1) if grid[y][x] != bg]
        colors = {grid[y][x] for y,x in cells}
        fill = next(iter(colors)) if len(colors) == 1 else grid[(y0+y1)//2][(x0+x1)//2]
        band = next(b for b in bands if b[2] == fill)
        dest_y = band[1] - (y1-y0)
        for y,x in cells:
            out[y][x] = bg
        for y,x in cells:
            out[dest_y+y-y0][x] = band[3] if grid[y][x] != fill else fill
    return out
'''
